title: Kagamine Len — Reluctant Reconciliation〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sigh... I do want to patch things up with Rin, but I don't know how to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you all for the help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But Akito was so determined to make up with Toya as well. I can do this too...
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO! Is Rin here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Len.
Rin was here just a short while ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... I must have just missed her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, looks like you're ready to make up with her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes... I don't really have the courage, but I also know I can't keep letting this drag on.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd be so uncool if I didn't at least try after encouraging someone else to make up with his friend, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll go look for Rin again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm sure she'll understand if you talk to her properly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, when Rin was in the shop just now, she was telling me she wanted to patch things up with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? Rin said that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. She said she wanted to patch things up and then have some lemon soda together with you again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I have to find her quickly, then!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be fine. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! See you later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, it's dangerous to break into a run like that.
Be careful...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yikes! Ah, sorry... Huh? Rin?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Rin, I just...need to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes... Um, maybe we can go over there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Looks like everything's going to work out right.
You can do this, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Humhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello, again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Judging from your expression, you've managed to patch things up with Rin, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That I did!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin actually listened and understood what I had to say. If I'd known it'd be so easy, I would've done it sooner!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You two have always been thick as thieves, after all. I'm glad everything's fine between you now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After making up, we started singing at the street outside. It was really fun to sing with Rin again after so long!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku showed up halfway through, and they're singing together now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I guess I should start preparing some lemon soda, then?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe! I came back again because I thought of the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can I order some for takeout? I'm going to take the drinks to Miku and Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. Three lemon sodas it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why not four?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should join us once in a while too, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's not like there are any customers around right now... I'll help you out with the cafe later in return!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Since you asked so nicely, maybe I should oblige.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To celebrate you and Rin making up with each other.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Four lemon sodas, and a Closed sign...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Done. Shall we go now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Miku and Rin are gonna be so happy to see you!
